sources.title: TrustLLMeu/trustllm-v2-8b-sft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model has approximately 7.19 billion total parameters, 24 layers, 64 routed experts with top-8 routing, and one shared expert. SFT used full-parameter training with Jiangtao's TorchTitan fork and DiSCO optimizer on 16 H100 GPUs at MareNostrum 5.

sources.title: TrustLLMeu/trustllm-v2-8b-sft-8k · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is TrustLLMeu/trustllm-v2-8b-midtrain-sft (the "M3" model, also main of trustllm-v2-8b-sft since 27 September 2026) after a further 256 training steps at 8,192 tokens. M3 was fine-tuned at 4,096 tokens. It still predicts text well up to 8k, but it lost long-range recall: it fails to retrieve a passkey placed about 7,000 tokens back. This continuation restores that recall.

sources.snippet: Fredrik Heintz, Professor of Computer Science at Linköping University, is a key figure in managing the TrustLLM project. With expertise in trustworthy AI, he shared insights on the project's vision, challenges, and innovations shaping AI's future in Europe, highlighting the importance of collaboration and autonomy.
